model.method: Season HR per plate appearance, regressed to the league rate, scaled by the opposing probable starter's regressed HR-allowed rate, over a league-average number of trips to the plate.
notModelled: batting-order slot (trips to the plate are a league average, not this batter's lineup spot)
bullpen faced after the starter leaves
model.honestLimit: Settled from official box scores: 37 of 247 graded picks homered against 55.5 expected. No accuracy claim is made at this sample size, and no home-run market price is fetched, so it makes no claim to beat a sportsbook. It is the model's own read, published so it can be measured.
